summary: Conditional getter that reads two single-bit flags out of the complement of this[15] (dword field at offset 0x3C). If a2 is non-null it is set to bit 1 ((~this[15] >> 1) & 1); if a3 is non-null it is set to bit 2 ((~this[15] >> 2) & 1). Always returns a3.

operations.description: Guard on a2 being non-null before writing the first bit through it.
Extract bit 1 of the complement of dword field this[15]: ((~this[15] >> 1) & 1).
Store the extracted bit-1 value into *a2.
Guard on a3 being non-null before writing the second bit through it.
Extract bit 2 of the complement of dword field this[15]: ((~this[15] >> 2) & 1).
Store the extracted bit-2 value into *a3.
Return a3 (null-safe; no effect when a3 is null).
